_comment: BASE TEMPLATE — Do not remove or modify framework schema sections. This is a forward-looking queue for unfinished work only; runtime state resets to defaults on directive completion.

_persistentState.description: PERSISTENT ACTIVE-WORK SCHEMA — Reference for approved task decomposition, targeted research, and implementation dispatch. Strategic plan evidence is the default basis; Phase A research is optional and reserved for blockers, drift, external facts, or material uncertainty. This template is immutable — it defines the contract, not the work.

structure.phaseId: Descriptive hyphenated ID derived exactly from PLAN.md
structure.planPhaseRef: Exact phase row governed by an approved PLAN.md subject
structure.phaseDescription: The high-level goal, boundaries, and context of this phase as defined by the Architect
structure.state: pending | researching | spec_ready | implementing | completed | blocked | paused

_taskId.id: Log-unique descriptive task ID prefixed by the exact Directive ID recorded in PLAN.md and matching phase hierarchy
_taskId.description: Unfinished action item required to achieve the active phase goal
_taskId.state: pending | researching | spec_ready | implementing | completed | blocked | paused

optionalTaskState.description: Attach only while the corresponding state is active; remove after its result is synthesized into researchBasis, phaseB_ImplementationSpec, or progressEntries.

phaseA_Research.presentWhen: targeted research is active or a returned result is being synthesized
phaseA_Research.purpose: Blocker, drift, external fact, or material uncertainty that could change this task

blockerLog.presentWhen: state is blocked, researching that blocker, or paused from either state; remove only after resolution is synthesized

lookaheadPhases.description: Unfinished downstream task shells from the Architect-approved PLAN.md. Each entry mirrors the phase-scoped root shape (phaseId, planPhaseRef, phaseDescription, state, phaseHealth, tasks, phaseSuccessCriteria, progressEntries); the global activeAgents registry remains at the runtime root. Lookahead tasks may be pending/researching/spec_ready/blocked/paused but never implementing until the phase is promoted to root. Do not retain completed tasks, raw research history, or stale superseded briefs here.

activeAgents.description: Live registry of currently-open agent handles (agent id/name, served task or strategic-question ID, root/lookahead/strategic phase, state: researching/implementing/verifying, dispatch timestamp). Add on dispatch; remove on retire. A verifier handle does not add a new task state: its task remains implementing until the Orchestrator accepts its evidence. Consult before any new dispatch and reconcile with host live handles on resume. Resets to empty on directive completion.
